title: Add image-memory and appearance tables to database models
description:
Modify chatbot/db/models.py to add ImageMemory and Appearance models plus a nullable appearance_id foreign key on the existing companion model, integrating with the existing memory/provenance model rather than a parallel store.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- chatbot/db/models.py (existing database models — understand SQLAlchemy base class, column conventions, existing table names, memory model class name, companion model class name, and existing provenance columns)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/db/models.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed path. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed file modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

Implementation details:

1. Open chatbot/db/models.py and understand:
   - The SQLAlchemy declarative base class and import conventions.
   - Existing model class names for Companion (from earlier auth/companion phases) and Memory (from earlier memory phases).
   - Column naming conventions and existing relationship patterns.
   - Existing memory model table name (the table that holds pgvector embeddings and provenance columns).

2. Add an `ImageMemory` SQLAlchemy declarative model class with table name 'image_memories':
   - `id` (Column(Integer), primary_key=True, autoincrement=True) or use existing primary key convention.
   - `image_id` (Column(String(36)), unique=True, nullable=False, default=uuid4 string).
   - `source_type` (Column(String(20)), nullable=False): Literal['generated', 'uploaded', 'understood'].
   - `turn_id` (Column(String(64)), nullable=True): the conversation turn that produced or received this image.
   - `session_id` (Column(String(64)), nullable=True): the session context.
   - `user_id` (Column(String(36)), nullable=True): FK to users table (nullable because system-generated images may have no user).
   - `image_data` (Column(LargeBinary), nullable=True): the raw image bytes. Nullable for external-URL images.
   - `image_url` (Column(String(1024)), nullable=True): external URL for the image. Nullable for locally stored images.
   - `mime_type` (Column(String(64)), nullable=False): e.g. 'image/png', 'image/jpeg'.
   - `prompt_used` (Column(Text), nullable=True): the generation prompt (for generated images).
   - `seed_used` (Column(Integer), nullable=True): the random seed (for generated images).
   - `model_used` (Column(String(128)), nullable=True): the provider/model that generated or understood the image.
   - `width` (Column(Integer), nullable=True), `height` (Column(Integer), nullable=True): pixel dimensions.
   - `generation_time_ms` (Column(Float), nullable=True): generation latency.
   - `description` (Column(Text), nullable=True): AI-generated description (for understood images).
   - `detected_objects` (Column(JSON), nullable=True): JSON array of detected objects.
   - `detected_text` (Column(Text), nullable=True): OCR'd text from the image.
   - `scene_category` (Column(String(128)), nullable=True): scene classification.
   - `understanding_confidence` (Column(Float), nullable=True): confidence score from understanding.
   - `processing_time_ms` (Column(Float), nullable=True): understanding latency.
   - `created_at` (Column(DateTime), nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow).
   - Use nullable columns for generation-specific and understanding-specific fields so one table serves both purposes.

3. Add an `Appearance` SQLAlchemy declarative model class with table name 'appearances':
   - `id` (Column(Integer), primary_key=True, autoincrement=True).
   - `appearance_id` (Column(String(36)), unique=True, nullable=False, default=uuid4 string).
   - `companion_id` (Column(String(36)), nullable=True): the companion this appearance belongs to. FK to companions table.
   - `character_seed` (Column(Integer), nullable=False, default=42).
   - `character_description` (Column(Text), nullable=False, default='').
   - `visual_traits` (Column(JSON), nullable=False, default=list): JSON array of trait strings.
   - `art_style` (Column(String(128)), nullable=False, default='digital illustration').
   - `color_palette` (Column(JSON), nullable=False, default=list): JSON array of hex color strings.
   - `created_at` (Column(DateTime), nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow).
   - `updated_at` (Column(DateTime), nullable=True, onupdate=datetime.utcnow).

4. Add an `OutfitRecord` SQLAlchemy declarative model class with table name 'outfit_records':
   - `id` (Column(Integer), primary_key=True, autoincrement=True).
   - `outfit_id` (Column(String(36)), unique=True, nullable=False, default=uuid4 string).
   - `appearance_id` (Column(String(36)), nullable=False): FK to appearances table.
   - `name` (Column(String(128)), nullable=False, default='default').
   - `description` (Column(Text), nullable=False, default='').
   - `visual_tags` (Column(JSON), nullable=False, default=list): JSON array of tag strings.
   - `is_active` (Column(Boolean), nullable=False, default=False).
   - `created_at` (Column(DateTime), nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow).

5. Add an `appearance_id` column to the existing Companion model:
   - `appearance_id` (Column(String(36)), ForeignKey('appearances.appearance_id'), nullable=True).

6. Do not modify existing columns, table names, or model class names.
7. Ensure all new JSON columns have sensible defaults (empty list).
